plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Add path override fields to settings page for Python, yt-dlp, ffmpeg, and Node.js. Shows red warning when an override path doesn't exist. Useful for non-standard installs especially on Windows. Thanks to Paul Webster for the suggestion.
